selection_exposure: Exploratory after known R1-R9 quantitative summaries and multiple failed hypotheses; not blinded discovery. No new gene, count, matrix, classifier or endpoint outcomes.

opportunities.question: Is between-specimen bulk RNA dispersion greater in native EMC than source-matched LGFMS/MLPS, with a consequential sampling or model decision?
opportunities.computability: Positive: 13 EMC, 13 LGFMS and 14 MLPS in accessible same-study TPM.
opportunities.prior_art: Hofvander diagnosis-conditioned silhouette cohesion/separation and outlier assessment; Brenca native fusion-partner programs and tissue-preparation concordance. Pure dispersion is mathematically distinct from silhouette and is not claimed already answered.
opportunities.failure: Current proposed model/biopsy consequence confuses between-patient bulk spread with within-patient biopsy/culture representation; no distinct consequential decision established.
alternatives: Pairwise distances are not independent patients
opportunities.status: NO-GO for current stated value; not data/assay impossibility or rejection of every variance question.

opportunities.question: Do authenticated native EMC culture RNA profiles represent the native EMC population relative to same-normalization other sarcoma cultures and native tissue controls sufficiently to guide experimental model selection?
opportunities.use: Select models whose disease-associated RNA state is retained relative to other cultured sarcomas before a disease-specific perturbation/localization experiment. This is a conditional population comparison, not within-donor retention.
opportunities.difference: Same-donor fidelity gate did not establish released paired RNA; population comparison need not require same-donor pairs. Primary PDC-to-TCGA comparisons do not supply an authenticated native EMC tissue reference.
opportunities.favorable: Native model physical origin/STR source authentication; accessible 13 native tissue TPM and two existing ARCHS4 EMC culture profiles. RNA-only value allowed without mandatory protein/functional/clinical assays.
opportunities.current_failure: Retained two-column ARCHS4 subset lacks other cultured sarcoma controls; estimated-count versus TPM/RefSeq capture and annotation normalization and mixture/handling controls not established.
opportunities.pending: Ten-GSM GSE221532 extract declares sample supplemental NONE, but contains no series fields. Series-level processed files, public API gene tables, author deposits and same-normalization culture controls remain genuinely pending.
opportunities.status: Potential useful question, not execution-ready numerical proposal; targeted-marker negatives do not decide whole-profile representation.
